moments.text: Infrared view: a dark blotch at upper centre over a streaky grey surface. The view pans right, carrying a pale dash and dark specks off to the left.
A tiny bright dot shows just below the crosshair and stays near it as the view keeps panning; faint at first.
A long dark streak sweeps across the top of the frame; afterwards the background is smooth, even grey.
The dot holds just right of and below the crosshair, growing brighter; faint horizontal ripples later fill the lower half.

notes: Grey side panels not cropped (crop null). The official 00:01 entry from the left edge is not visible; the dot is first seen near the crosshair at ~5.5 s.
